name: Camp Warsofsky
description_short: A 10-week summer day camp run by the Boys & Girls Club of Marshfield, with campers split into groups by age (5-6, 7-8, 9-11). Days include swimming, STEM, sports, arts & crafts and outdoor games, and there is a separate Junior Leadership Camp for grades 6-9.
